title: Array push vs concat

bugs.explanation: `push()` mutates the array and returns the new *length* of the array (4), not the array itself. If you need the modified array, either use `arr` directly or use `arr.concat(4)` which returns a new array.

splice Mutates
indexOf Returns -1 for Not Found

bugs.explanation: `indexOf()` returns `-1` when the element is not found. Since `-1` is truthy, the `if` block runs even when the element is absent. Always compare explicitly: `arr.indexOf(5) !== -1` or use `arr.includes(5)`.

title: find Returns undefined
filter Returns New Array
map Returns New Array
reduce Initial Value
reduce on Empty Array Without Initial
code:
const empty = [];
const sum = empty.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n);

bugs.fix: const sum = empty.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n, 0);
bugs.explanation: Calling `reduce()` on an empty array without an initial value throws `TypeError: Reduce of empty array with no initial value`. Always provide a safe initial value as the second argument.
